text:
Maya Chen: Morning — starting onboarding orientation for Foundry Labs (acct: FOUND-197). Goal: 30-day live eval, 60-day pilot, renewal-ready at 90d. Need stakeholder roster, success criteria, and any compliance blockers.
Oliver (Foundry PM): Thanks Maya. Quick priorities from our side: security approval by week 2, SSO integration, and data sovereignty constraints. I'll invite infra + security leads after this thread.
Liam Patel: I'll own model integration + SDK touchpoints. ETA for sample embed flow: end of this week.
Ana Rodriguez: I'll handle enablement docs and training. Propose two 1‑hr sessions (week 2 & week 4) — one for engineers, one for product.
Priya Singh: Risk flag — Foundry requires SOC2 evid and HSM-backed KMS. Do we have Private deployment checklist and KMS playbook ready?
Maya Chen: Yes — Private deployment checklist here: https://redwood.internal/onboard/private-checklist (internal). Also requesting @OnboardBot to create playbook and tasks for FOUND-197.
OnboardBot: playbook created: /tasks/FOUND-197-playbook — first automated check-in scheduled 2024-09-12 16:00 UTC.
Oliver (Foundry PM): Can we get a short milestone timeline? Helps me align their PM and infra.
Maya Chen: Sure — rough timeline below:
```
Week 0: contract sign + SSO kickoff
Week 1: security docs delivered + infra scoping
Week 2: enablement session 1 + model validation
Week 4: pilot soft launch (limited traffic)
Week 8: performance tuning + cost optimization
Week 12: renewal-readiness review
```
Liam Patel: Noted. I'll need their sample dataset and a token budget. Oliver — can you confirm dataset access and retention policy?
Oliver (Foundry PM): I'll confirm dataset share + retention by EOD. Also looping in their infra lead in a follow-up invite.
Ana Rodriguez: I'll draft the agenda for session 1 (integration checklist + evaluation metrics) and share by Tue.
Priya Singh: Legal/compliance question — do we need a DPA addendum for pilot telemetry? Rebecca, can you advise?
Rebecca (Legal): I'll review NDA vs DPA requirements and share comments by Tue afternoon. If they insist on HSM KMS, we'll need the Private deployment agreement addendum.
Maya Chen: Action items summary: Oliver to confirm infra contacts & dataset by EOD; Liam to post any integration blockers into the playbook; Ana to send session invites and agenda; Rebecca to review legal docs. I'll run first 15m check-in on Thursday.
Oliver (Foundry PM): Will do — thanks team :thumbsup:
Liam Patel: I'll upload initial SDK snippets to the playbook once I get the dataset.
Ana Rodriguez: Tentative enablement sessions scheduled — will update calendar invites.
Maya Chen: Great — if any blockers surface, drop them here or tag me. Otherwise meet in the first check-in.
